cards.title: IVF Grief: Greg Wise on Loss and Identity
cards.body: Actor Greg Wise reflects on how he and Emma Thompson coped with failed IVF cycles, describing the profound emotional and identity crisis the experience created. Two decades later, he shares how the couple processed their grief and what it taught them about resilience.

cards.title: Adult Kids Living at Home: Making It Work
cards.body: With record numbers of adult children staying home, experts reveal how to create harmony between generations. Key strategies include setting clear ground rules early, respecting privacy, and avoiding reverting to old parent-child dynamics.

cards.title: Human Connection Matters More Than Tech Fears
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection is a bigger threat to children than AI or screens. Open, frequent conversation between parents and kids is the real solution to tech concerns.

cards.title: Peer Bullying Affects Teens' Self-Image Later
cards.body: Recent research shows that peer victimization predicts worse self-portrayals in teens the following year. The negative effects persist when bullying continues over time.

cards.title: Joy and Play Unlock Children's Learning Potential
cards.body: Joyful play and arts-based emotional connection activate the brain for learning and development. This approach transforms daily resistance into powerful educational opportunities.

cards.title: Emotionally Abusive Families Leave Lasting Effects
cards.body: Children who witness one parent repeatedly belittle or control the other experience lasting psychological impacts. Understanding these effects is crucial for breaking cycles of emotional abuse.

cards.title: Echolalia in Toddlers: Learning or Something More?
cards.body: Repeating words helps toddlers develop language skills, but echolalia can also signal autism or other developmental differences. Understanding this developmental phase helps parents support their child's communication growth.

cards.title: Emotion Regulation: The Foundational Skill for Kids
cards.body: Emotion regulation is the core skill that underlies all other development and wellbeing. Families and schools can teach this critical skill early to set children up for success.

cards.title: Late Autism Diagnosis: Complex Emotions and Recovery
cards.body: Adults receiving an autism diagnosis later in life experience mixed emotions about their past. For those with eating disorders, this diagnosis can be transformative in their recovery journey.

cards.title: Family Scapegoating: Breaking the Pattern
cards.body: Sometimes the 'problem' child is actually the one brave enough to name family dysfunction. Learning to stop carrying blame and betraying yourself is key to breaking free from scapegoating.

cards.title: Halloween Candy: Building Guilt-Free Food Relationships
cards.body: Worried about Halloween candy overload? Experts recommend ditching food rules and diet culture to help kids develop healthy attitudes toward treats. Sharing sweets with your kids can build confidence around food choices.
